The kitchen comes equipped with a fridge, sink, oven, stovetop, as well as upgraded appliances.

The neighbourhood is close to public transit, which means you won’t be far from all Arlington has to offer.

lastMessage.text:
Hi everyone,

Thank you all for being part of the home. This is a friendly reminder for everyone to continue being respectful of one another and mindful of shared living spaces.

Please remember the following house and PadSplit rules:

• Loud music should always be kept at a considerate volume, regardless of the time of day.  
• Please close the front door firmly behind you, but avoid slamming it.  
• Guests are not permitted inside the home at any time.  
• Common courtesy should be practiced daily. Everyone has different schedules, so please be respectful and considerate of your housemates.  
• Clean up after yourself after using shared spaces, including washing dishes and cleaning the toilet after use.  
• Keeping the home clean is everyone’s responsibility, not just one person’s. Please do your part to maintain a clean and comfortable environment for all residents.  

Please continue following all house rules and PadSplit policies to help maintain a peaceful and respectful home for everyone.

Failure to follow house rules may result in warnings or further consequences if issues continue.

Thank you all for your cooperation and understanding.
